description: Accessibilité bus PMR par commune is a dataset listed in Open Data Seine-Saint-Denis, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Département de Seine-Saint-Denis. Ce jeu de données a été créé dans le but de connaitre le taux d'accessibilité des arrêts de bus pour les personnes à mobilité réduite (PMR) par commune en 2021 et 2022. Le taux est calculé par le Bureau des Etudes de Déplacement (BED). Coverage: Seine-Saint-Denis. The portal files it under Transport, Movements. Its keywords are DVD, accessibilité, bus, pmr, arrêt, transport. The portal shows 40 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open licence (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/open-licence.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-seinesaintdenis-fr-portal.
